title: Bypass `minimumDeployVestTime` due to vestingEnd overflow
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `g8keepFactory` contract implements a minimum vesting period for token deployers through the `minimumDeployVestTime` parameter.
